rows.title: Vitamin D Deficiency in Hip Fracture Patients: Outcome-Specific Associations and Post-Fracture Management-A Narrative Review.
rows.evidence_boundary: Association and supplementation evidence is heterogeneous; multimodal benefits cannot be attributed to vitamin D alone.

rows.title: Oxidative Stress in Vascular Aging: Therapeutic Potential of the Antioxidant Paradox. A State-of-the-Art Review.
rows.evidence_boundary: Preclinical promise contrasts with inconsistent large clinical trials; current evidence does not support antioxidant supplementation for cardiovascular prevention.

rows.title: Precision Nutraceuticals and Biomarkers of Healthy Aging: A Scoping Review of Human Studies on Nutrigenomic-Based Interventions.
rows.evidence_boundary: Intermediate biomarker changes do not establish slowed biological aging or clinical benefit.

rows.title: Potential interactions between creatine supplementation and prescription drugs: a narrative review and evidence-mapping perspective.
rows.evidence_boundary: No controlled human interaction studies were found; absence of documented interactions is not evidence of no risk.

rows.title: Current evidence and emerging therapeutic strategies for non-exercise interventions in sarcopenia associated with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease: a narrative review.
rows.evidence_boundary: Evidence tiers span clinical, preclinical, and translational data; findings cannot be generalized across intervention classes.
